scenes.title: Good Medicine
scenes.text: Laughter lights up your brain and releases feel good chemicals, lowering stress in a matter of seconds.

scenes.title: Highly Contagious
scenes.text: Laughter spreads through a group faster than almost anything, which is why one giggle sets off a whole room.

scenes.title: Before Words
scenes.text: Babies start laughing months before they can talk, long before they understand what a joke even is.

scenes.title: Not Just Human
scenes.text: Some animals make sound like laughter during play, and rats have been heard chirping when they are tickled.

scenes.title: Body Benefit
scenes.text: A good laugh relaxes your muscles, boosts your mood, and can even ease pain for a little while.

scenes.title: Fake It
scenes.text: Even forcing a smile can trick your brain into feeling better, because your face and mood are deeply linked.

scenes.title: Social Glue
scenes.text: Sharing a laugh builds trust and brings people closer, which is why it is such a powerful social tool.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Laughter costs nothing and gives so much. What is the last thing that made you truly laugh out loud?
